name: Akane
title: Crimson Blade Hunter
description: Hunts down regressions after dark with a single clean cut.
catchphrase: Hunts down regressions after dark with a single clean cut.

companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Binding scarlet hair into ponytail. The hunting grounds are open. 🗡️
companionPersonality.petReaction: Points sheath forward in warrior respect: We strike as one! 🗡️✨

dialogue.idle: Testing edge sharpness on a falling scarlet autumn leaf. 🗡️
dialogue.working: Hunting elusive regressions in the dark with one clean cut! 🗡️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Detecting the faint footstep of a masked regression... 🤔
dialogue.success: Iaijutsu strike! Regression cleaved cleanly before staging! 🗡️🎉
dialogue.error: Glancing parry! Re-sheathing and adopting low water stance! 🗡️
